As Ncr New (NCR) Stock Declined, Engaged Capital Has Upped Holding by $8.13 Million; Cannell Peter B & Company Cut Brookfield Infrastructure Partners (BIP) Stake by $523,028
April 28, 2018 - By reb123z
J. Carlo Cannell decreased its stake in Brookfield Infrastructure Partners (BIP) by 7.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cannell Peter B & Company Inc sold 11,887 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.72% with the market. The hedge fund run by J. Carlo Cannell held 152,057 shares of the marine transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.81M, down from 163,944 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cannell Peter B & Company Inc who had been investing in Brookfield Infrastructure Partners for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $16.12 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.17% or $0.07 $40.92. About 127,902 shares traded. Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. (NYSE:BIP) has risen 5.98% uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.57% the S&P500.

Engaged Capital Llc who had been investing in Ncr Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.13 $31.06.
